## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), see CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits. It becomes the commit message on `main`.
- [ ] No real host names, tenant names, IP addresses, tokens or personal data, only placeholders.
- [ ] No source code copied from other projects, in particular from other MCP servers for ChurchTools. Exceptions only after a prior decision, recorded in NOTICE (ADR 0002).
- [ ] Every new dependency is justified in its commit message: purpose, licence, alternatives.
- [ ] Documentation, `docs/STATUS.md` and ADRs are updated where needed.
